note: Meitou only: things worn in the helper's neck slot (Trophies.cs, Meitou 0.18+; on 0.17 they stay in the bag). The keepsake goes to a fallen squadmate's mourner; the charms are the faction gifts' second item (gen_title_temperaments.py CHARMS); each named outlaw's token is made with the outlaw (content.py make_outlaw). The warrant is dropped by a beaten bounty hunters' crew (Hunters.cs).

lore_items.name: Keepsake of the Fallen
lore_items.description:
Something small that belonged to a squadmate who did not make it, kept by the one who stood over them. It is worth nothing to anyone else.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Okran's Token
lore_items.description:
A small brass sun on a cord, the kind the faithful give to those who serve the Nation well. Paladins will notice it.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Shek Battle Knot
lore_items.description:
A knot of red cord the Shek tie for warriors they respect. Wearing one you did not earn would be a quick way to die.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Noble's Favour
lore_items.description:
A lacquered tag stamped with a noble house's crest. In the Cities, being owed by the right family is worth more than cats.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Guild Marker
lore_items.description:
A stamped trade marker the Guild hands to people it wants to keep doing business with. Opens doors, closes questions.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Tech Hunter Pin
lore_items.description:
A tarnished pin from the Tech Hunters, given to outsiders who proved useful in the field. They remember who wears one.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Broken Shackle Charm
lore_items.description:
A link of broken chain on a leather thong. The Anti-Slavers give it to those who stood against the slavers.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Flotsam Ribbon
lore_items.description:
A faded ribbon the Flotsam Ninjas tie on friends of the cause. A Holy Nation patrol would not like seeing it on you.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Guild Coin
lore_items.description:
An old guild coin with a hole punched through it. Mercenaries give these to fighters they would stand beside.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Nomad Bead String
lore_items.description:
A string of carved beads from the Nomads, who give them to those who share the road with them. Each bead is a story.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Drifter's Charm
lore_items.description:
A twist of wire and glass the Drifters pass to those they trust. Worth nothing, and they will never forget who has one.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Swamp Fang
lore_items.description:
A swamp creature's fang on a cord. The Swampers give them to people who can handle themselves out there.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Bounty Hunter's Warrant
lore_items.description:
A town's warrant with your squad's description and price on it, taken off the bounty hunters it hired to bring you in. They didn't manage it.

Worth nothing to a trader. Worth keeping all the same.
